scope: Model-owned fixed KV pool sizing and launch log metadata. Host-only source/test validation; no TTNN import, model inference or device launch.
changes: Added GEMMA4_KV_POOL_IDS for batches 1, 8, 16, and 32 at max_model_len 262144, with canonical positive decimal validation and context-preserving per-batch minimum IDs.

The synthetic worker token budget subtracts one 32-token output reserve and eight 1024-token sliding-window reserves per sequence, so the pinned worker heuristic reconstructs the requested pool ID count.
The legacy GEMMA4_B8_KV_POOL_IDS=20480 path and its other-batch behavior remain unchanged; simultaneous legacy and new overrides are rejected.
serving_pool_budget logging reports requested/effective pool IDs, source, synthetic budget, total tokens with reserves, minimum, and reserve components.
The existing validate_pool_memory fit check and runtime error remain in place; requested IDs do not bypass measured allocator free-memory validation.

coverage: old defaults and B8 legacy constants
worker reserve cancellation and exact pool reconstruction
malformed, conflicting, unsupported-batch/context and subminimum override rejection
tests.imports: Test dynamically loads kv_pool_budget.py and inspects generator_vllm.py as text; no TTNN import.
